independent_derivation.proof: For q=floor(N/R)>=2, distribute N-qR residual sites among q base-R intervals. Every length is between R and2R-1: N-qR<=q(R-1) follows from N<=q(2R-1), using q>=2 and R>=2; R=1 is exact. There are q incoming interval boundaries. Uniform cyclic shift sends each fixed positive-axis edge to a boundary on exactly q of N shifts, hence cut probability q/N<=1/R. Independent shifts of three coordinates give at most(2R-1)^3<8R^3 sites/box. R=N/2 still gives two contractible intervals; no open box wraps a full coordinate cycle.

The four-field tuple lives in a real Hilbert space with total HS metric. Projection onto its closed radius-L ball is 1-Lipschitz and commutes with simultaneous unitary conjugation. Therefore ||cap(Phi_x)-Ad_U cap(Phi_y)||<=||Phi_x-Ad_U Phi_y|| edgewise, giving A(Psi,U)<=A(Phi,U). At a site Psi=tPhi with one common nonnegative t for all four fields. Each anticommutator-square trace is nonnegative and homogeneous degree4, so J(Psi)=t^4 J(Phi)<=J(Phi). This argument would be false for separate coordinate clipping; none is used.

For any Hermitian perturbation Delta h, |K_k(h+Delta h)-K_k(h)|<=||Delta h||1 from the defining density-matrix maximum. A4x4 onsite perturbation costs ||mDeltaPhi0||1<=2|m| delta_x, where delta_x is the total tuple HS distance. An offdiagonal edge with block Delta f has rank<=8 and trace norm2||Delta f||1<=4||Delta f||HS. Endpoint averaging gives ||Delta f||HS<=b(delta_x+delta_y)/2. Six endpoint incidences/site thus cost12b sum delta_x. Hence ||Delta h||1<=D sum delta_x. For radial cap delta_x=(r_x-L)_+<=r_x 1_{r_x>L}<=r_x^4/L^3. This proves the tail price DVM/L^3 uniformly for every global rank2V density, not just a special sea.

Use root coordinates and canonical paths increasing axis0, then1, then2. Parent of x deletes its final positive step; all tree paths have length at most3(2R-2)<6R. Let P_x be the ordered native link product root-to-x and Psi'_x=P_x Psi_x P_x^dag; U'_xy=P_x Uxy P_y^dag. A tree edge becomes I. Along the tree, differences in root fields are unitary conjugates of actual edge alignment differences. Cauchy bounds ||Psi'_x-Psi'_root||tuple^2 by6R times the sum along its path. Sum over at most8R^3 vertices bounds it by48R^4 A_box. The HS mean B minimizes the squared error, so sum_x||Psi'_x-B||tuple^2<=48R^4 A_box. Every B_mu stays traceless Hermitian and joint norm<=L by convexity; B is an arbitrary four-matrix tuple, not a Clifford tuple. Summing boxes gives the displayed global48R^4 A.

For an internal positive-axis i edge, concatenate canonical path(x) and step i. Bubble this last i step left across higher-axis steps until the word equals canonical path(y). Each exchange j,i -> i,j at vertex v replaces A=Uj(v) Ui(v+ej) by B=Ui(v) Uj(v+ei). The ratio of complete old/new path products is Pprefix A B^dag Pprefix^dag: the common suffix cancels, but the conjugation does not. Multiplying these ratios telescopes exactly to P_x Uxy P_y^dag. There are at most4R exchanges (two later coordinates each<2R), in particular <=12R^2. Each exchange is an actual native plaquette or its reversed orientation, counted without multiplicity for this canonical path. For unitary factors ||product T-I||HS<=sum||T-I||HS; conjugation invariance and Cauchy give ||U'_e-I||HS^2<=12R^2 sum_filling||Uface-I||HS^2<=24R^2 C_box. At most24R^3 internal positive edges yields sum_e||U'_e-I||HS^2<=576R^5 C_box. No commutative Stokes theorem, all-links flattening, global holonomy erasure or centre projection occurs. Exact face-product conjugations are consumed in the new CLI.

The scalar AP connection restricted to each contractible box is a vertex-sign coboundary, including a box crossing the torus coordinate seam. Local vertex signs remove internal AP factors while leaving all holonomy on omitted interbox edges. The original global h and all AP edge blocks remain unchanged before cutting. Since ||Psi||tuple<=L, ||f_edge||HS<=bL and the Hermitian crossing block trace norm<=4bL, rank<=8. There are3V positive native edges and cut probability<=1/R, so averaged boundary trace norm<=12bLV/R. This is the cost of cutting, not permission to discard global AP or centre sectors.

The endpoint trace calculation from trace_tail also applies on open boxes: field replacement costs<=D sum_x||Psi'_x-B_box||tuple<=D sqrt(48R^4 VA). Next, at constant B with joint norm<=L, replacing residual U'_e by I costs<=4bL||U'_e-I||HS per edge (each endpoint operator norm<=L). At most3V edges and the proven residual bound give total link trace price<=4bL sqrt(1728R^5 VC). No imaginary c_i or endpoint conjugation is dropped.

Write a_mu=||Pmu||HS and d_mu=||dPmu||HS, with sum a_mu^2<=L^2. The ordered anticommutator array Q has ||Q||array<=2L^2. Its derivative satisfies ||dQ||array<=4L||dP||tuple by HS product inequalities and the outer-product triangle bound. Because J=4||Q||array^2, |dJ|<=8||Q||array||dQ||array<=64L^3||dP||tuple. Thus the claimed1024L^3 is conservative by a factor16. The segment between Psi'_x and its HS mean remains in the joint radius-L ball. Integrate the derivative and sum/Cauchy to obtain |J(Psi')-sum_box|box|J(B_box)|<=1024L^3 sqrt(48R^4 VA). All16 ordered pairs are indispensable; diagonal-only is rejected by the consumer.

H0 is the direct sum of native open constant arbitrary-matrix boxes, each with onsite mB0 and all three endpoint-averaged axes. K_2V(H0) maximizes globally over all complete box eigenlevels with total2V, equivalently over integer box ranks0..4|box|. Negative levels and compensating ranks remain; fixed2|box| and positive-part truncation are different functionals. Combining cap, tree, Jordan, field and link prices for every partition, then averaging only its cut price, proves existence of a shift p with (J-K_2V(h))/V >= [sum_box |box|J(B_box)-K_2V(H0)]/V - E_RL, E_RL=(1024L^3+D)sqrt(48R^4 A/V)+4bL sqrt(1728R^5 C/V)+12bL/R+DM/L^3. This matches route1 without replacing the bracket by an antecedent periodic uniform theorem.

Disintegrate the finite-N physical quantum state over Cartesian/Haar/U1 configuration, retaining its full charged/Ref fibre. For almost every configuration with nonzero norm, the reduced neutral onebody density obeys0<=Gamma<=I and TrGamma=2V because the entire neutral fibre has fixed global particle number2V; mixed states use the same CAR fact. TrGamma h<=K_2V(h), including all signed levels. Pointwise comparison therefore integrates. A mathematically explicit safe form averages the bracket over ALL finitely many translated partitions; every shift has the same tree/Jordan/link bounds and the averaged cut cost is<=12bLV/R. Alternatively choose a measurable finite minimizing-cut shift at each configuration. One cannot silently use an arbitrary fixed shift with the averaged boundary constant. Jensen/Cauchy gives errors at <A/V>,<C/V>,<M>. Configuration-dependent box means are comparison variables, not an adopted ground field. This clarifies the target's 'some partition' bracket when used inside the quantum expectation.
